title: Tradeify list prices and homepage promotions can diverge
summary: Tradeify's June 24 pricing reference still maps 12 base purchases to account sizes. On 11 August, the homepage mixed 30%, 35%, and 40% promotion copy with placeholder card values; the Select 50K reset was $109 while its base purchase remained $165.
traderImpact: The comparison stores the stable purchase price, not a temporary coupon or reset. Confirm the final discounted amount, reset cost, and product name in checkout before paying.

title: LucidDaily launched with 4 configurable evaluation paths
summary: Lucid's help centre still documents 4 Daily variants, but the homepage selector omits Daily and its trading-hours page does not cover Daily. A general page broadly restricts red-folder news, while the funded-product page narrows the hard-breach window to U.S. high-impact USD events.
traderImpact: Confirm that Daily is purchasable and verify the exact DLL, drawdown, price, overnight, weekend, and news-calendar scope at checkout; no stable public Daily price was captured.

title: Apex moved new purchases to 4 one-time evaluation paths
summary: Products bought after 1 March 2026 use Intraday or EOD drawdown with Standard or No Activation Fee pricing. The prior recurring products are Legacy.
traderImpact: Older Apex reviews can describe a different billing and drawdown structure. Match any comparison to the product name shown at checkout.

title: TradeDay monthly prices were tied to a 55%-off promotion
summary: The 55%-off TDNEW monthly fees were unchanged on 11 August, but crossed-out list prices still conflict with TradeDay's support table and reset prices differ across the homepage and billing articles.
traderImpact: Treat the table price as a dated promotional snapshot. Recheck the first month, renewal, and reset totals before paying.

title: FundingPips separates the current Standard path from legacy 10% resets
summary: The current 2 Step Standard Phase 1 target is 8%. FundingPips says legacy Standard accounts carrying a 10% target reset as 2 Step Flex.
traderImpact: A reset can place an older account into a different product rule set. Confirm the product name and target after any reset.

title: Alpha Capital's own pages disagree on a 25K Pro price
summary: One official cost page states $137 for the 25K Alpha Pro 6% variant, while a separate official review page states $197 for a 25K Alpha Pro without identifying the target variant.
traderImpact: The $137 figure is retained only for the explicitly labelled 6% product. Verify the selected target and final checkout total before purchase.

title: Alpha One prices do not identify the rule variant
summary: Alpha's cost table labels tiers only as Alpha One, while its plan page documents 6%, 10% and 12% variants with different targets, drawdown limits and size caps. The captured rules use the 10% variant, but the fee-to-variant mapping is unresolved.
traderImpact: Confirm the selected variant, its target, drawdown, account-size ceiling and final fee before paying; do not assume the stored fee buys the 10% rule set.

title: Alpha Capital disagrees on Alpha One payout schedules
summary: The homepage advertises Bi-Weekly or On-Demand with Alpha One selected, while the 2026 rules article and bi-weekly help article limit bi-weekly payouts to Alpha Pro and Alpha Three. The data retains the narrower on-demand schedule for Alpha One.
traderImpact: Confirm whether the purchased Alpha One account offers a 14-day cycle, on-demand requests or both before planning cash flow.

title: E8 Pro pages disagree on prices and configurable terms
summary: The current E8PRO v2 page lists $38 to $2,998 and fixed 8% target, 8% static drawdown and 2.5% daily-cap terms, with an 80% default or paid 100% add-on. Current help still shows the older $32 to $2,598 ladder, while an older custom-account article also lists 6%, 8% or 10% drawdown and a 90% payout variant.
traderImpact: The comparison follows the current product-specific v2 page and does not infer variant prices. Confirm the size, drawdown, payout option, platform surcharge and final total in checkout.

title: E8 One pages disagree on the default target and drawdown
summary: The rendered configurator and product page default to a 9% target, 4% daily drawdown and 6% trailing maximum drawdown, while E8's help article calls 6% target, 3% daily and 4% dynamic drawdown the preset. The comparison follows the rendered configuration attached to the captured prices.
traderImpact: Verify the selected target, daily limit and maximum drawdown in the order confirmation before trading; Indian profiles are additionally capped at the $50K E8 One tier.

title: Maven publishes conflicting Instant payout timing
summary: Maven's pricing page says Instant payouts are available when requirements are met, while its FAQ and Terms specify a 10-business-day interval.
traderImpact: The comparison leaves Instant payout timing unknown. Confirm the first eligible request date and later cadence in the selected account terms before purchase.

title: Maven's Prediction pages disagree on loss limits
summary: The pricing page presents a 5% Phase-1 and 8% funded maximum loss for both Prediction paths, while the FAQ describes Essential as 3% trailing and Elite as 5% static.
traderImpact: Maximum-loss values remain unknown in the comparison. Confirm the exact Essential or Elite rule set shown in the account agreement before purchase.

title: New TradeDay Fast Pass accounts use funded consistency
summary: Fast Pass Funded Sim accounts opened on or after 26 July 2026 must meet 45% gross-profit consistency for each payout; older accounts retain no funded consistency objective.
traderImpact: An account's open date now changes payout eligibility. Check whether the 45% rule applies before sizing a payout request.

title: TradeDay disagrees on Fast Pass days and a payout cap
summary: The homepage says 3 minimum trading days while current support says no formal minimum; the 100K funded payout cap is $1,875 on the homepage and $1,850 in support.
traderImpact: The comparison leaves the minimum-day field unknown and does not choose a disputed 100K cap. Confirm both rules for the exact account before purchase or payout.
